_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Reclaiming the House#000.src: I need more firepower if I'm going...to get...

Reclaiming the House#001.src: Anyway, it's clear that I'm going to need more firepower if I'm going to have a shot at reclaiming that outpost.

Reclaiming the House#002.src: Wh- I'm shocked! In the middle there- they just caged the soldiers instead of killing them? That's...kind of a relief.
Reclaiming the House#002.dst: 뭐- 놀랍네! 저 가운데- 병사들을 죽이지 않고 가둬 두기만 했어? 그건... 좀 다행이네.

Reclaiming the House#003.src: There's definitely too many orcs in the plaza there for us to take down on our own...

Reclaiming the House#004.src: Alright, now I just need to figure out how we can both get in... There's sentries on the perimeter, so going over may not be an option...

Reclaiming the House#006.src: Oh, orc from mud bath. In, now!

Reclaiming the House#007.src: No enter for humans! This place belong to orcs!

Reclaiming the House#009.src: Ah... Took mud bath. Orc enter, quick!

Reclaiming the House#011.src: The Gavellian Army's sending reinforcements to our outpost, finally. Everything was getting too much to handle on our end.

Reclaiming the House#012.src: You Wynnic folks are way better suited than us for guard duty. Why don't you take over for me, huh?

Reclaiming the House#013.src: Join Elphaba on a mission in the Temporary Camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Reclaiming the House#014.src: Oh, a Wynnic soldier out here in the boondocks? Honestly, you're just what we need- I could use your help, if you're able?
Reclaiming the House#014.dst: 어, 이런 외진 곳에 Wynn 병사가? 솔직히 딱 필요한 사람이야- 괜찮다면 좀 도와줄 수 있어?
Reclaiming the House#014.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#015.src: Good, thank you. Let me lock down the camp before I give you the briefing, though.
Reclaiming the House#015.dst: 좋아, 고마워. 그래도 브리핑 전에 야영지부터 봉쇄할게.
Reclaiming the House#015.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#016.src: My name is Elphaba. I've been working with the Gavellian army for a good few years now.
Reclaiming the House#016.dst: 난 Elphaba야. Gavel 군대에서 일한 지 벌써 몇 년 됐어.
Reclaiming the House#016.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#017.src: I'm the commander of the {p} Outpost down ahead. It's a strategic fortress, placed to monitor the Orcish capital.
Reclaiming the House#017.dst: 저 앞 {p} 전초기지의 지휘관이야. 오크 수도를 감시하려고 세운 전략 요새지.
Reclaiming the House#017.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#018.src: It was safe for a long while, but especially in the past while the Orcs have gotten far bolder, more aggressive.
Reclaiming the House#018.dst: 오랫동안 안전했는데, 특히 요즘 들어 오크들이 훨씬 대담하고 공격적으로 변했어.
Reclaiming the House#018.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#019.src: They overwhelmed the outpost- we had to retreat and set up this camp to watch over the place we used to watch over them with!
Reclaiming the House#019.dst: 놈들이 전초기지를 휩쓸었어- 우린 후퇴해서, 놈들을 감시하던 그곳을 감시하려고 이 야영지를 세워야 했지!
Reclaiming the House#019.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#021.src: ...oh no. See, this is what I mean! The orcs are coming!
Reclaiming the House#021.dst: ...이런. 봐, 내 말이 이거야! 오크들이 온다!
Reclaiming the House#021.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#022.src: Brace yourself, soldier! Protect the camp!
Reclaiming the House#022.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#023.src: Kill the mobs raiding the Camp.

Reclaiming the House#024.src: This is the third attack in three days! How many reinforcements have they got?!
Reclaiming the House#024.dst: 사흘 동안 벌써 세 번째 공격이야! 증원이 대체 얼마나 되는 거야?!
Reclaiming the House#024.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#025.src: Gah! Their casters are strong, careful!
Reclaiming the House#025.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#026.src: Talk to Elphaba for information on the upcoming attack.
Reclaiming the House#026.dst: Elphaba와 대화해 다가올 공격에 대한 정보를 들으세요.

Reclaiming the House#027.src: Ugh, I think that was all of them... Come here now, I'll start up where we left off.
Reclaiming the House#027.dst: 으, 이제 다 처리한 것 같아... 이리 와, 아까 하던 얘기 계속할게.
Reclaiming the House#027.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#028.src: Not sure I could have done that myself. I'm lucky you came around when you did, soldier.
Reclaiming the House#028.dst: 나 혼자선 못 막았을 거야. 딱 그때 네가 와 줘서 다행이야, 병사.
Reclaiming the House#028.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#029.src: Anyway, it's clear I'm going to need more firepower if I'm going to have a shot at reclaiming that outpost.
Reclaiming the House#029.dst: 어쨌든, 저 전초기지를 되찾을 가망이라도 있으려면 화력이 더 필요한 게 분명해.
Reclaiming the House#029.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#030.src: You've certainly got the fighting chops, so I'd appreciate the aid, but we've got to come up with a plan, fast.
Reclaiming the House#030.dst: 싸움 실력은 확실하니 도와주면 고맙겠지만, 빨리 계획을 세워야 해.
Reclaiming the House#030.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#031.src: There's an old tower near the outpost- some old storage silo. It was built taller than the fort, so we might be able to spy on them from there.
Reclaiming the House#031.dst: 전초기지 근처에 오래된 탑이 있어- 낡은 저장고 탑이지. 요새보다 높게 지어져서 거기서 정찰할 수 있을지도 몰라.
Reclaiming the House#031.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#032.src: It's a risk though, since it's so close by, but we have no other options. Meet me at the tower southeast of here so we can survey the situation.
Reclaiming the House#032.dst: 워낙 가까워서 위험하긴 하지만, 다른 방법이 없어. 여기서 남동쪽에 있는 탑에서 만나서 상황을 살펴보자.
Reclaiming the House#032.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#033.src: Go to the watch tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to plan the attack.

Reclaiming the House#034.src: Soldier! I'm right behind you. You can see our outpost- and the tower I mentioned.
Reclaiming the House#034.dst: 병사! 바로 뒤에 있어. 우리 전초기지랑- 내가 말한 탑이 보이지.
Reclaiming the House#034.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#035.src: We need to find a way in. A lot of soldiers were caught unaware during the Orcs' assault, too.
Reclaiming the House#035.dst: 들어갈 방법을 찾아야 해. 오크들이 습격했을 때 방심하던 병사도 많았어.
Reclaiming the House#035.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#036.src: If there's any survivors in there, we should make rescuing them a priority.
Reclaiming the House#036.dst: 안에 생존자가 있다면 구출하는 걸 최우선으로 해야 해.
Reclaiming the House#036.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#037.src: After all, it means more manpower for us. We can't count on that being the case, though...
Reclaiming the House#037.dst: 결국 그만큼 우리 병력이 늘어나는 거니까. 그렇다고 기대할 수는 없지만...
Reclaiming the House#037.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#038.src: Come on, hurry inside before one of the orcs spots us!
Reclaiming the House#038.dst: 자, 오크한테 들키기 전에 서둘러 안으로 들어가!
Reclaiming the House#038.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#039.src: Enter to the watch tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to plan the attack.

Reclaiming the House#040.src: Alright, this is a pretty clear view. Let's see what's going on in there...
Reclaiming the House#040.dst: 좋아, 시야가 탁 트였네. 안에서 무슨 일이 벌어지는지 보자...
Reclaiming the House#040.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#042.src: There's definitely too many orcs in the plaza for us to take down on our own...
Reclaiming the House#042.dst: 광장에 오크가 너무 많아서 우리끼리는 절대 못 쓰러뜨려...
Reclaiming the House#042.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#043.src: ...but that cage is held up by those ropes. If we can cut them, the other soldiers should be able to help!
Reclaiming the House#043.dst: ...그런데 저 우리는 밧줄로 매달려 있어. 밧줄을 끊으면 다른 병사들이 도와줄 수 있을 거야!
Reclaiming the House#043.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#044.src: Alright, now I just need to figure out how we can both get in... There's sentries on the perimeter, so going over may no be an option...
Reclaiming the House#044.dst: 좋아, 이제 둘 다 들어갈 방법만 찾으면 돼... 외곽에 보초가 있으니, 넘어가는 건 안 될 것 같고...
Reclaiming the House#044.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#045.src: Maybe we can keep an eye out on their sentry patterns and look for an opening-
Reclaiming the House#045.dst: 보초들 움직임을 지켜보면서 빈틈을 찾을 수 있을지도-
Reclaiming the House#045.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#046.src: Humans on old tower! Junhur will shoot! This our place now, get out!!
Reclaiming the House#046.dst: 오래된 탑에 인간! Junhur 쏜다! 여기 이제 우리 땅, 나가!!
Reclaiming the House#046.speaker: Orc

Reclaiming the House#047.src: Aw, not now! I knew this was a risk, no time to get out... Brace for impact!!
Reclaiming the House#047.dst: 아, 하필 지금! 위험할 줄 알았는데, 나갈 시간이 없어... 충격 대비해!!
Reclaiming the House#047.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#048.src: Old tower fall! Junhur is best cannon shooter!!
Reclaiming the House#048.dst: 오래된 탑 무너짐! Junhur 최고의 대포 사수!!
Reclaiming the House#048.speaker: Orc

Reclaiming the House#049.src: Agh, soldier!! Are you alright, where'd you fall?!
Reclaiming the House#049.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#050.src: Ah... Wow. You barely look scratched, you must've gotten really lucky.
Reclaiming the House#050.dst: 아... 와. 긁힌 데도 거의 없네, 운이 엄청 좋았나 봐.
Reclaiming the House#050.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#051.src: Not so much here... I'm pretty battered after that. At least one of us is in good condition...
Reclaiming the House#051.dst: 난 그렇지 못했어... 아까 그걸로 꽤 다쳤어. 한 명이라도 멀쩡해서 다행이지...
Reclaiming the House#051.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#052.src: Unfortunately, that means figuring a way in is up to you. We can't examine their sentry patterns from down here.
Reclaiming the House#052.dst: 안타깝게도, 들어갈 방법은 네가 찾아야 해. 여기 아래선 보초 움직임을 살필 수가 없어.
Reclaiming the House#052.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#053.src: I'll survive, sure, but I won't be able to walk around and defend myself for a while.
Reclaiming the House#053.dst: 죽진 않겠지만, 한동안은 걸어 다니거나 내 몸 하나 지키기도 힘들 거야.
Reclaiming the House#053.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#054.src: I hate leaving you on your own like this, but if it's any consolation, you should be tough enough, or lucky enough, to get through.
Reclaiming the House#054.dst: 이렇게 혼자 보내긴 싫지만, 위안이 될지 모르겠네. 넌 충분히 강하거나, 충분히 운이 좋으니 해낼 거야.
Reclaiming the House#054.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#055.src: Explore the perimeter of the outpost. Try to find a way in, but be careful, okay?
Reclaiming the House#055.dst: 전초기지 외곽을 살펴봐. 들어갈 길을 찾아 봐, 하지만 조심해, 알았지?
Reclaiming the House#055.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#056.src: Explore the outpost's surroundings to find another way in.
Reclaiming the House#056.dst: 전초기지 주변을 탐색해 다른 진입로를 찾으세요.

Reclaiming the House#057.src: Follow the trail of mud left by the orc. It leads to the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Reclaiming the House#057.dst: 오크가 남긴 진흙 자국을 따라가세요. [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 동굴로 이어집니다

Reclaiming the House#058.src: Enter the outpost while covered in mud.

Reclaiming the House#060.src: Cut the ropes to free the guards from the cage.
Reclaiming the House#060.dst: 밧줄을 끊어 우리에서 경비병들을 풀어 주세요.

Reclaiming the House#062.src: Good thinking with the mud disguise, soldier! They never suspected a thing, now come help us out over here!
Reclaiming the House#062.dst: 진흙 변장이라니 머리 잘 썼어, 병사! 놈들은 전혀 눈치 못 챘어, 이제 이쪽 좀 도와줘!
Reclaiming the House#062.speaker: Soldier

Reclaiming the House#063.src: Kill the Orcish Overtakers, we'll help keep the other ones off you!
Reclaiming the House#063.dst: Orcish Overtaker를 처치해, 다른 놈들은 우리가 막아 줄게!
Reclaiming the House#063.speaker: Soldier

Reclaiming the House#064.src: Open the gate with a spell

Reclaiming the House#065.src: The Overtakers are down, the other Orcs are flailing! Open the outpost's entrance with a spell now, we've got this under control!
Reclaiming the House#065.dst: Overtaker들이 쓰러졌고 다른 오크들은 우왕좌왕해! 이제 주문으로 전초기지 입구를 열어, 여긴 우리가 맡을게!
Reclaiming the House#065.speaker: Soldier

Reclaiming the House#067.src: Phew... That's some fine work there, soldier! The outpost is back under our control!
Reclaiming the House#067.dst: 휴... 훌륭한 솜씨였어, 병사! 전초기지를 되찾았어!
Reclaiming the House#067.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#068.src: Glad to see some more capable Wynnic hands over here. Though, I didn't catch your name. Would you mind?
Reclaiming the House#068.dst: 여기 유능한 Wynn 사람이 더 와서 다행이야. 그런데 이름을 못 들었네. 알려 줄래?
Reclaiming the House#068.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#069.src: {u}, huh? I'll remember that. You barely even needed my help, heh... Wish I hadn't been such a burden, but at least it worked out.
Reclaiming the House#069.dst: {u}, 그렇구나? 기억해 둘게. 내 도움은 거의 필요 없었네, 헤... 짐만 된 것 같아 아쉽지만, 어쨌든 잘 풀렸어.
Reclaiming the House#069.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#070.src: Here- it's some of my own personal spending money, as a thank-you gift.
Reclaiming the House#070.dst: 여기- 내 개인 용돈 좀 떼어 온 거야, 감사의 선물로.
Reclaiming the House#070.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#071.src: Alright everyone, let's get this place ship-shape! Everything needs to be repaired in case of another attack!!
Reclaiming the House#071.dst: 자 모두, 여기를 말끔히 정비하자! 또 공격받을 때를 대비해서 전부 수리해야 해!!
Reclaiming the House#071.speaker: Elphaba
